beats.text: SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA
beats.subtitle: A perfectly ordinary day off.

beats.text:
Mick Magnum. Fighter pilot. Ocean enthusiast.
Tango’s best friend.

beats.speaker: pete
beats.text: Go talk to her, man! You miss 100% of the shots you don’t take.

beats.speaker: pete
beats.text: You’re a hero, Mick. Remember that time over Korea when I was out of fuel, and you tilted your plane into mine so just enough fuel got into my tank to make it home?

beats.speaker: pete
beats.text: You saved my life that day, and I will never forget it. Take Tango with you, bro. You know ladies can’t resist this cute little troublemaker.
Tiffany Seasons. On duty.

Mick finally makes his approach. Tango stays close.
Six figures reach the tower first.
A stolen whistle. A very bad idea.

beats.speaker: mick
beats.text: Do you all have a problem? Because it looks like you’re picking on the lifeguard.

beats.speaker: keno
beats.text: What’s it to you, pretty boy? You trying to get into her pants? Better wait your turn, because I’m getting there first.

beats.speaker: mick
beats.text: Don’t talk about her that way! Show her some respect and give her back her whistle, you losers. Or there’s gonna be high-altitude trouble.

beats.speaker: steve
beats.text: Hey, Keno! This guy thinks he’s some kind of hero. Look at him, with that haircut and those shades. What are you, some type of movie character?

beats.speaker: mick
beats.text: I’m a pilot, and I’ve served my entire life. As a baby, on the national tricycle Olympic team. In elementary school, as leader of the national hall monitor association.

beats.speaker: mick
beats.text: In high school, as a state champion soccer player. In college, as leader of the Air Force Reserves. And now, in Korea, in Russia, in Poland, in Brazil…

beats.speaker: mick
beats.text: …as the Captain of Top Gun. The most elite Air Force unit in existence, protecting the weak and promoting freedom all over the world!
The entire gang has stopped listening.

beats.speaker: gang
beats.text:
“Haha, what a chump!”  /  “This guy’s submissive to authority.”
“Is your mom your co-pilot too?”  /  “What a sucker.”

beats.speaker: gang
beats.text:
“I zoned out, but this guy is hot.”
“I’d never want to have a beer with this guy.”
“I’m not crying, you’re crying.”

beats.speaker: keno
beats.text: Look, flyboy, the lady isn’t interested. She’s got bigger goals in mind. This airspace is too much of a danger zone for you. We wouldn’t want to see you… crash and burn.

beats.speaker: mick
beats.text: You think you can take me, tough guy? You probably can’t even spell your own name. Walk away, all of you, or I’m going six-G target lock.

beats.speaker: jason
beats.text: Stop toying with him, Keno, and let’s get out of here. We’ve got a reservation with a bar stool, and Alex is buying.

beats.speaker: alex
beats.text: I’m not buying. You haven’t paid your last ten bills!

beats.speaker: jimmy
beats.text: Well, it’s hard to pay bills when you show up late for your roofing job every day, because your primary job of partying keeps you out all night!

beats.speaker: pete
beats.text: That explains the roof at your bar.

beats.speaker: alex
beats.text: It explains the buckets at my bar.
While Steve is distracted, Tiffany takes back her whistle.

beats.speaker: tiffany
beats.text: There. Everybody’s had their fun. Go bother a parking meter.

beats.speaker: mick
beats.text: You heard the lady.

beats.speaker: tiffany
beats.text: I was doing pretty well before the speech.

beats.speaker: mick
beats.text: Absolutely. I was providing air support.

beats.speaker: keno
beats.text: Cute. You two practice fetching together?

Jimmy laughs. Then catches himself.
Keno notices.
The rim begins to hum.

beats.speaker: alex
beats.text: Put that away, Keno.

beats.speaker: keno
beats.text: Relax. The captain’s got great reflexes.
Tango moves first.

beats.speaker: mick
beats.text: Tango?

beats.speaker: mick
beats.text: Come on, buddy.

His tennis ball rolls down the sand.
It stops against Mick’s hand.

beats.speaker: mick
beats.text: Tiff…?

beats.speaker: tiffany
beats.text: Pete, bring my truck around.

beats.speaker: mick
beats.text: He’s not moving.

beats.speaker: tiffany
beats.text: We need to go. Right now.

Pete and Tiffany lift Tango onto a towel.
His collar slips loose. Mick catches it.

The truck pulls away.
Mick stays in the sand.

beats.speaker: steve
beats.text: Technically, the dog entered the flight path.

beats.speaker: vanessa
beats.text: Shut up.

beats.speaker: keno
beats.text: Wasn’t aiming at the dog.

beats.speaker: mick
beats.text: You should start running.

beats.speaker: vanessa
beats.text: Leave. Now. You smelly losers.
The gang retreats along the boardwalk.

SIX NAMES.
ONE WAY UP.
THE LEAKY TIKI
beats.subtitle: FIRST CHALLENGE  /  ALEX ALOHA
